## Brief
Owner steer, 2026-10-02: recalibrate Travel & Tourism toward professional, clean, organized and premium with controlled creativity. Review all nine Spacious Woodblock Road / Stamp Rally / Concourse designs, especially Stamp Rally, and Marine Flagship Golden Blue. Produce one new two-page Spacious concept on the existing fictional sample, blending Flagship discipline, selective Japanese travel identity and subtle nature. Proposed design only; owner decides adoption.

## Acceptance
- All nine reference designs and Golden Blue inspected visually.
- One new reproducible Typst concept, PDF, current Meta File and page previews.
- Retain / simplify / remove explanation with source principles.
- Independent research and visual review, including each page in a batch sheet.
- No production package, private data or frozen-reference changes.

## Working context
Branch docs/idea-run-2026-10-02-editor inherits codex/repo-agents and older unmerged design work. Intended delivery target is this proposal branch; do not merge its ancestry wholesale into main.
Live owner checkpoints: no deletions, overwrites or destructive Git without explicit approval. Fresh render paths only.
## Delivery, 2026-10-02
Done on the intended proposal branch docs/idea-run-2026-10-02-editor; not merged into main because inherited earlier design work still has open gates. The design stays proposed, not adopted.

Commit: https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen/commit/aa179c32035a71de33b6bbfe284df0c9da43b1e5
PDF: https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen/blob/aa179c32035a71de33b6bbfe284df0c9da43b1e5/design-concepts/2026-10-02-japan-passage/spacious/stylish/spacious-stylish.pdf
Analysis and run evidence: https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen/tree/aa179c32035a71de33b6bbfe284df0c9da43b1e5/docs/work/idea-runs/2026-10-02-editor
CI: https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen/actions/runs/37025533262 (completed, success for exact published commit)

Closed multi-dimension loop: research PASS round1; design PASS round1 for both pages/all8criteria; reader PASS round1; shared aggregate-participation Note fixed and fresh reader closure PASS round2. No unresolved findings. Final2pageA4PDF pixel-identical to reviewed snapshot at200dpi, fictional sample byte-identical, all10 reference PDFs unchanged. Output Contract:25PDFs indexed,0problems. Current Meta File:proposed/spacious/stylish/travel. Compiler:exit0,no warnings.

## Handoff
Owner reviews Japan Passage's professional/creative balance. Retained Flagship hierarchy/spacing/premiumfinish; selective travel/Japan/escort illustration and clean seal; low-opacity cherry margin artwork. Removed literal tickets/barcodes/guilloche/rotations/repeated stamps. Production adoption remains a separate owner decision and Claude implementation task.

# session-handoff

Rewritten in place at the end of every session; the first thing a fresh session reads after AGENTS.md. Holds only what no task card owns: what is next, parked owner decisions, machine facts, pitfalls. Task state stays on the task cards.

**Written:** 2026-10-02, repo-scoped Codex agent setup and current-state checks (Codex).
**Main at:** 0488c4f8496b06af201db4969e88f7298b52d7f5

## Current orientation
- Current checkout: codex/repo-agents, created from the pre-existing docs/idea-run-2026-09-29-editor checkout (8551dae). The completed setup task owns its final evidence: https://trello.com/c/pc3a0vY1 . Do not merge that branch wholesale into main: its ancestry includes the earlier design-run work whose gates were left open. The Codex setup itself changes only new .codex files and its review records.
- Main is unchanged in this session. Its exact-head CI succeeded: https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen/actions/runs/36901796640 . Reviews for intervening main work are under docs/work/design-review-app, output-contract, anti-examples, repo-maintenance and atlas; their historical checks were not rerun here.
- Shared repo skills remain in .claude/skills and can be read directly by Codex. Local native custom agents use standalone .codex/agents/*.toml. The implementation/Claude gate policy has not changed.
- Trello was read live. Existing Queued cards: trello-cli (conditional), travel-domain, deck-data, codex-visual-tools. The new Codex setup card owns its current review/integration state. No other Active/Review/Ready or Blocked cards were shown.

## Next
- Use .codex/README.md for the new agent roles and invocation notes. For the continuing product work, re-verify the older design-run and codex-visual-tools context below against its branch, task and exact evidence before acting.
- Atlas check reports five inherited STALE pages: client-journey, design-run, change-review, system-map and roster. The roster does not yet describe the new Codex counterparts. Updating the existing Atlas files was outside this .codex setup and was not performed.
- The client-workflow proposal still says status: approved, while its task card is Done and implementation exists. Reconcile metadata with evidence before calling it unapplied work; no new product decision was inferred.

## Machine checks and pitfalls
- Native Codex CLI 0.160.0 successfully initializes the new repo agent definitions. Actual model-driven Codex role invocation was not exercised.
- codex debug prompt-input omits the custom-role catalog: existing AGENTS.md name mentions are not discovery proof. The app-server ephemeral thread/start loader accepts a valid trusted clone and warns on a duplicate-role negative control.
- Main-checkout loader gives an unrelated existing warning: user config mcp_servers.Sanity.type is ignored. Global configuration was not changed.
- Restricted Claude invocation did not auto-discover code-reviewer; the review was launched with an explicit --agents file containing the exact repository reviewer prompt, Opus high. A fresh second round also allowed read-only Git and returned PASS; reports and dispositions are on the task card.
- No night is open, no follow-up is open; the 2026-09-28-a night JSON has no unanswered questions or unsent feedback.
- Repo quick audit: no Critical/High findings; inherited map-length and path-depth heuristics remain. Generated builds/ evidence was preserved, with no cleanup.

## Constraints in force
- The owner's live checkpoints override older broader Git/cleanup permissions: explicit confirmation before overwrites, deletions, directory removals, generated/cache cleanup or discarding work; destructive Git also requires it. Routine reads, edits, checks and non-destructive Git remain authorized.
- Never approve a real Client's PDF. Public content remains fictional; private briefs use Alias only. Consent and Sign-off rules remain intact.
- Codex code-reviewer is advisory and does not replace the implementation review gate reserved to Claude.

The following was the previous handoff. Its branch heads, counts and open findings are historical claims, not current proof. It is retained so ongoing design work is not lost; verify it before resuming.
# session-handoff

Rewritten in place at the end of every session; the first thing a fresh session reads after AGENTS.md. Holds only what no task card owns: what is next, parked owner decisions, machine facts, pitfalls. Task state stays on the task cards.

**Written:** 2026-09-29 late, design-is-the-product core on main; idea run and codex/context branches open (Claude Code).
**Main at:** cae0828

## Where things stand
- `main` at cae0828, pushed. Today on main: "Design is the product" (owner 2026-09-29) in docs/vision.md + pointers (AGENTS, preferences, review.md, client-workflow, new-cv, idea-run, new-theme) + restated in ceo, ceo-reviewer, magazine-editor (now 3 Styles x 3 Design Tiers = 9 pages), design-reviewer (Batch Test, Three-Second Test, Flagship Parity blocking; batch sheets). New terms: Batch Test, Three-Second Test, Flagship Parity, Design Tier, Style. Code-review rounds 1-2, PASS.
- client-2026-09-01 (Travel & Tourism, tour escort, Japan): draft-02 signed off. Line Diagram CV REJECTED by the owner ("super boring, no Japan"); its revisions stay unapproved in the Envelope as history.
- Idea run 2026-09-29 (branch docs/idea-run-2026-09-29-editor, pushed, NOT merged): 9 pages on fictional data, styles Woodblock Road, Stamp Rally, Concourse. Research and design gates NOT run (owner asked to stop). Owner has seen the contact sheet (builds/editor-2026-09-29/contact-sheet.png). Open: gates (design cap 10, owner), Japanese font sizes (kaisei-tokumin 4.4 MB, m-plus-1p 3.4 MB), glossary terms Station Board, Stamp Card.
- Branch docs/codex-visual-tools (pushed, NOT merged): proposal codex-visual-tools (approved by owner: Codex GPT-6 Astra high = second visual reviewer, GPT-6 Sol high = image generation; card codex-visual-tools in Queued) + new agents context-maintainer and context-reviewer (adapted from night-shift, wired into review.md, AGENTS.md). Reviews FINDINGS, OPEN: docs/work/codex-visual-tools/reviews/01.md (F1 --ephemeral, F2 --ignore-user-config + no AGENTS.md) and docs/work/design-core/reviews/03-context-reviewer.md (F1 review.md loop names both reviewers, F2 role/specialty vs glossary Role/Rank).

## Next
1. Apply the two open review reports on docs/codex-visual-tools, re-review with the context-reviewer (new agents load in a fresh session), merge.
2. Build codex-visual-reviewer + Sol image step per the proposal (safe flags!), then run the idea run's research + design gates (design-reviewer AND codex reviewer) up to 10 rounds; show the owner the passed pages; he picks Style + Tier for client-2026-09-01; build his CV from it (new-cv client design loop).
## Parked owner decisions
- Deck cadet as a public `Release` example with its own `Frozen Reference` (not asked yet).
- Taste calls raised, not blocking: the ship's wheel top knob touches the page edge on no-portrait deck pages; education stays numbered "03" when certificates are missing.
- One copper: logo files use #B7713D, First Fitting and the form theme #B0602B (brand/README.md open item).

## Pitfalls that cost time
- Windows console is cp1252: subprocess text needs `encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'`; Python prints of Greek need PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8.
- Bash heredocs that write files or commit sometimes do nothing silently: commit from PowerShell with a here-string. (Worked fine all this session.)
- [IO.File] in PowerShell resolves relative paths against the process folder, not Set-Location: use absolute paths.
- A stale .git/index.lock appeared in the main checkout once; remove it only after checking Get-Process git.
- Pushing HEAD:main from a side branch is blocked by the harness; fast-forward main in a checkout of main instead.
- The Edit/Write tools fail on a file not Read in this session, or changed since (including by your own shell edits): Read again first.
- The workflow test asserts engine_uncommitted_changes is False: commit engine changes before `python tests/run.py`.
- The owner wants files opened on his screen (Invoke-Item) plus their paths. An image opened that way is locked: cp fails with Permission denied; PowerShell Copy-Item -Force works.
- Store reviewer reports UNCHANGED in docs/work/<id>/reviews/ (docs/review.md), dispositions below. This session condensed them first and had to restore them (0e3e6c8).
- Google Apps Script: FormApp cannot set a form's theme (header, colour, fonts); the owner does it by hand. `node --check` needs the .gs file on stdin. Forms made by script after 30 June 2026 need setPublished(true).
- Briefs to subagents name a client by Alias only, never the Envelope folder (slip on 2026-09-29, caught by review).
- Bash heredocs in this tool collapse \\ to \: build Typst \u{..} escapes with chr(92) in Python.
- Form answers can echo our own option wording (a grid row "Hakone and Fuji", "e.g. on Zicasso"): check each CV claim traces to the client, not to the form.
- Block spacing in Typst collapses next to v(1fr) but not next to a fixed v(): restate a heading gap after flexible space.
- A reviewer running while you edit sees the dirty tree: commit before a round and do not edit during one.
- Trello credentials: never assign to a PowerShell variable; board resolved by name 'CVgen'.

## Constraints in force
- Never run `scripts/cv.py approve` on a real client.
- Outside private/, a client is only ever their Alias (client-yyyy-mm-nn).
- Before reading a client's documents, consent must be in intake/messages.md.
- Authority: agents act without asking on routine Git, board, builds/ cleanup and glossary terms (reported afterwards). Owner-reserved list: docs/preferences.md only.
- ICS VCR repos follow their own rules.

Owner: unassigned. Found by the docs-audit review round 2 (R2-N3), 2026-09-25; code reading only, not reproduced on the real workspace.

## Problem
`cv_workflow/render.py` snapshots `cv.typ`, `candidate.json` and the portrait into `revisions/<id>/inputs/`. A custom composition (build-a-cv section 8) that also reads a sibling file such as `presentation.json` either fails inside the snapshot (relative path) or reads the live file (root-absolute path), so the revision is not self-contained and approval does not bind to what was rendered.

## Outcome
Every file an entry point reads with `json(...)`/`read(...)`/`image(...)` from its workspace is snapshotted with its hash in `render.json`, or the render refuses with a message naming the file.

## Acceptance
- A workflow test with a sibling data file renders from the snapshot alone.
- Suite green; review PASS.

## Added 2026-09-25 (framework-split)
- docs/framework-gaps.md "A client whose domain does not exist yet": a one-off Template must fit in cv.typ because a revision snapshots only cv.typ, candidate.json and the portrait. This card closes that gap.
- Add a suite case to tests/workflow.py: a fictional one-off entry importing only /packages/cv-framework/lib.typ, rendered with --pages 1; assert success and schema null (framework-split review 02, R2-N3).
## What it fixes for a real person (plain words)
When you approve a client's CV, the approval is meant to lock in exactly the files that made that PDF, so the CV you send is the CV you checked. Until tonight a custom CV that kept extra facts in a side file (like the second real client's `presentation.json`) either failed to build from its saved copy or quietly read the live file, which could change after you approved; now every file the CV reads is saved with the revision, and a CV that still reads a live file cannot be approved.

## Result and evidence (Night Shift 2026-09-27)
- Merge: https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen/commit/20622b4 (suite PASS 52 cases on main after merging with certificate-validity-check).
- A revision now copies every workspace file `cv.typ` (or a local helper) reads by a literal path and lists it with its hash in render.json (`inputs.files`); refuses root-absolute reads into private/ or the workspace, paths leaving the workspace, missing files, a file taking the portrait's place; and after the compile, Typst's dependency list turns any `Live Read` (new glossary term) into a failed check, so approval is refused.
- Suite: a Framework-only one-off (schema null, --pages 1) with sibling data, a helper, a read after a URL; it compiles from the snapshot after the live files are deleted.
- Read-only probe of the two real compositions: one reads nothing extra, the other reads presentation.json by a relative path (now snapshotted); neither is refused. Not yet proven by a real render with the dependency check (next real render will show; a misfire would fail loudly, no data risk).
- Framework gap "A client whose domain does not exist yet": snapshot half closed.

## Review
- Round 1 FINDINGS: https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen/blob/main/docs/work/revision-snapshot/reviews/01.md (M1 URL comment stripping hid reads: fixed, plus the dependency-list safety net; m1-m4 fixed).
- Round 2 PASS: https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen/blob/main/docs/work/revision-snapshot/reviews/02.md. R2-m1 (an `include` inside an expression is not found; loud "file not found") documented in the cv-workflow README rather than widened; R2-N1 (check fails open on an odd dependency list or a network share) and round-1 N2 (schema chosen from cv.typ's imports only) deferred for triage.

## Handoff
Done. Deferred for triage: R2-m1, R2-N1, R1-N2 above.

# session-handoff

Rewritten in place at the end of every session; the first thing a fresh session reads after AGENTS.md. Holds only what no task card owns: what is next, parked owner decisions, machine facts, pitfalls. Task state stays on the task cards.

**Written:** 2026-09-25, Night Shift Protocol build (Claude Code).

## Where things stand
- `main` at 679912d, pushed, CI green (run 36128484592). Suite PASS 44 cases, engineer example pixel-identical to v11.
- Landed today (each reviewed to PASS, reports under docs/work/<id>/reviews/):
  - glossary (79ac1f9): docs/glossary.md is the official term list. Agents add, rename and drop terms without asking and name them in their next report to the owner. Official terms in backticks in every reply.
  - client-workflow (9598d5b): docs/guides/client-workflow.md + skill `new-client`. Not used on a real client yet (proposal stays approved until the first real run, then applied).
  - framework-split (679912d, ADR 0012): packages/cv-framework (core only) + packages/domains/marine (own lib.typ).
- Both private compositions re-pathed at merge (owner's OK), pixel-identical to their reference.pdf.
- Leftover worktree ../cvgen-framework-split and branch refactor/framework-split: removed (local + remote).
- Branch `feat/premium-draft` (2a5b337, pushed, NOT merged): first Text Draft house design, rejected by the owner ("no soul, character"). Kept only as reference; see card premium-text-draft. Its code-reviewer round was stopped as moot.
- Owner accepted (2026-09-25): consent wording + 12-month retention "keep it like this for now"; vision.md first line "exactly what we are aiming for".
- Working logo mark v3 (2026-09-25): brand/logos/CVgen_Logo.v3.jpg, commit d37644c. Raster draft; SVG, wordmark with "gen" and small-size variant are on card brand-logo (Queued).
- Client-data copies in builds/ deleted by the owner (2026-09-25). The deny rule `PowerShell(Remove-Item*private*)` still blocks agents from any path containing "private"; narrowing it to the private/ folder is the owner's option.

- **Night Shift Protocol adopted (trial, 2026-09-25, owner).** Decide by day, agents build unattended at night, owner reviews in the morning. Public repo https://github.com/jimzord12/night-shift, release v1 (2caba5b), launcher `night-shift` on the user PATH (~/.night-shift/bin). CVgen binding: docs/night-shift.md (commit 56de444). Board label `Night-ready` created. Questions live in cvgen/.night-shift/questions/ (git-ignored).
- **13 Day Shift questions** (2026-09-25-day-01..13) wait in the app: Block A quick decisions, the two ceo proposals, which roadmap items to prepare, design concepts, Text Draft route, logo next step, brand mood words. Next session: read the answers (`night-shift check .` shows open/answered), act, fill `resolved`, and turn them into Night-ready cards (header line `night-shift: kind=... size=... touches=...`).
## Next
1. Orient; then read the owner's answers to the 13 Day Shift questions and build the Night-ready buffer (aim 10-15 cards).
2. First real client: run the `new-client` skill.
3. Queued: brand-logo (vector + small mark), premium-text-draft (owner's direction on the card; suggested route: Idea Run with magazine-editor first), revision-snapshot (also closes the one-off Template gap + Framework-only render case), trello-cli (conditional).

## Parked owner decisions
- **Idea-gate exception** in docs/review.md (adopted by the lead 2026-09-25): confirm or refuse.
- **Two pending proposals** (ceo run): certificate-validity-check, vessel-particulars.
- **Three proposed design concepts** in design-concepts/: keep, drop or steer. May feed premium-text-draft.
- **Root exports/ PDFs** still carry "Marine CV" metadata; regenerating them replaces files in exports/ (owner-reserved).
- **D11:** the engineer example names a real academy; changing it breaks the frozen v11 reference.
- **Stray file** /tmp/a.txt from a reviewer; deleting it is the owner's call.

## Pitfalls that cost time
- Windows console is cp1252: subprocess text needs `encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'`.
- Bash heredocs that run Python or write files sometimes do nothing: write a .py file with the Write tool and run it from PowerShell.
- The Edit tool fails on a file not Read in this session; check `git grep '^<<<<<<<'` before `rebase --continue`.
- Deny rule matches any path containing "private": never name scratch folders with "private".
- The workflow test asserts `engine_uncommitted_changes is False`: commit engine changes before `python tests/run.py`.
- pymupdf: read `len(doc)` inside the `with` block.
- Forks cannot spawn the code-reviewer; the lead runs review rounds. The research-reviewer never reads private/: pass Deep Dives inline.
- Trello credentials: never assign to a PowerShell variable; board resolved by name 'CVgen'.
- Owner wants routine operations done and mentioned, not asked about.

## Constraints in force
- Never run `scripts/cv.py approve` on a real client.
- Outside private/, a client is only ever their Alias (client-yyyy-mm-nn).
- Authority: agents act without asking on routine Git, board, builds/ cleanup and glossary terms (reported afterwards). Owner-reserved list: docs/preferences.md only.
- ICS VCR repos follow their own rules.

1. Flat vector redraw (SVG), transparent background, no texture or shadows.

Rewritten in place at the end of every session; the first thing a fresh session reads after AGENTS.md. Holds only what no task card owns: what is next, parked owner decisions, machine facts, pitfalls. Task state stays on the task cards.

**Written:** 2026-09-25, overnight unattended session (Claude Code).

## Where things stand
- The project is **CVgen**: https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen, local folder `cvgen`, this board (id IPsBxAwf).
- `main` at 8f7bf35, pushed, CI green (run 36079889960), working tree clean, no other branches or worktrees.
- Merged overnight, each with a PASS code-review round, CI green:
  - docs-audit (db03370): doc fixes, agent authority in docs/preferences.md, PDF metadata renamed to CVgen in `domain.meta`.
  - candidate-validation (207e795): `cv.py render` refuses a candidate.json that breaks its schema (first ten fields, then a count); new dependency jsonschema 4.26.0.
  - component-contract (b264f1d): roadmap item 4 done; components are ctx-first, exported as `core-components` / `flagship-components`; old signatures kept as deprecated wrappers.
  - idea-agents (8f7bf35): agents ceo, ceo-reviewer, magazine-editor, design-reviewer, research-reviewer, and the `idea-run` skill.
- Suite: 43 cases, engineer example pixel-identical to v11 (builds/tests-20260925-035547-202757). Both private workspaces render pixel-identical to their reference.pdf under the new engine.
- Review caps (owner, 2026-09-25): 5 rounds attended, 10 unattended, for code review and idea gates.

## Next
1. Orient (AGENTS.md, preferences, this card, `-Cards 'CVgen'`, git state); give the Goal / Now / Next / You briefing, leading with the parked owner decisions below.
2. The idea agents load only at session start: this is the first session where `ceo` and `magazine-editor` can be started by name. Use them through the `idea-run` skill.
3. Owner's client CV: find out the field. Marine: `new-cv` skill. Any other field: open the travel-and-tourism (or that field's) domain card first (roadmap item 2).
4. Queued cards: revision-snapshot (sibling data files not snapshotted), trello-cli (conditional).

## Parked owner decisions
- **Idea-gate exception** in docs/review.md (adopted by the lead 2026-09-25): output of an idea run confined to design-concepts/, the run folder and pending proposals merges on the idea gates without a code-reviewer round. Confirm or refuse; replace the parenthesis with his dated decision.
- **Three pending proposals** (ceo run, all recommend Approve): certificate-validity-check (expired cert fails render checks; 0.5-1 day), vessel-particulars (GT, engine maker, kW per vessel; 1.5-2 days, slot with item 3), candidate-intake (client questionnaire; 0.5 day). Written before candidate-validation and item 4 landed; their "opened"/"after item 4" wording is now dated.
- **Three proposed design concepts** in design-concepts/ (README table): Measured in Months, Feature Opener, Fleet in Signs. Keep, drop or steer.
- **Root exports/ PDFs** still carry "Marine CV" in their metadata; regenerating them replaces files in exports/ (owner-reserved).
- **D11:** the engineer example names a real academy in its education entry; changing it breaks the frozen v11 reference (new reference + ADR).
- **Stray file** `/tmp/a.txt` written by a reviewer outside the repo; deleting it is the owner's call.
- trello-cli card: act only on its triggers.

## Pitfalls that cost time
- Windows console is cp1252: subprocess text from Typst/git needs `encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'`.
- Python `write_text` writes CRLF on Windows; the repo is LF-only (`newline='\n'`).
- Bash heredoc Python edits and `git commit` chained in Bash sometimes silently do nothing on this machine; use the Edit tool and PowerShell for commits, then check `git log`.
- `git add -A` in a worktree where an agent is still writing captures its half-done files; stage paths explicitly.
- The workflow test asserts `engine_uncommitted_changes is False`: commit engine changes before `python tests/run.py`.
- Forks cannot spawn the code-reviewer; the lead runs review rounds.
- A function stored in a Typst dictionary is called `(model.count)(x)`.
- Trello credentials: never assign to a PowerShell variable; board resolved by name `'CVgen'`.
- Identical inputs do not give identical PDF bytes; approval binds to bytes. Compiling a concept rewrites its committed PDF.

## Constraints in force
- Never run `scripts/cv.py approve` on a real candidate.
- Authority (owner, 2026-09-25): agents act without asking on routine Git and board work, including merges to main, branch/worktree cleanup and history edits on feature work. Owner-reserved list: docs/preferences.md only. `.claude/settings.local.json` holds matching allow/deny rules; start sessions inside `cvgen`.
- ICS VCR repos follow their own rules.

  - glossary (79ac1f9): docs/glossary.md is the official term list. Agents add, rename and drop terms without asking and name them in their next report to the owner (owner, 2026-09-25). Not used on a real client yet.
  - framework-split (679912d, ADR 0012): packages/cv-framework (core only) + packages/domains/marine (own lib.typ). A client with no domain gets a one-off Template whose cv.typ imports only /packages/cv-framework/lib.typ and holds the whole design.

## Next
1. Orient; give Goal / Now / Next / You, leading with the parked owner decisions below.
2. First real client: run the `new-client` skill. It also lists Envelopes whose intake is 3+ months old without Export, and passed delete-by dates.
3. Queued: revision-snapshot (now also closes the one-off Template gap and adds a Framework-only render case to tests/workflow.py), trello-cli (conditional).

## Parked owner decisions
- **Worktree with private-data copies:** ../cvgen-framework-split has builds/private-check-* (copies of real client records and portraits, ignored by Git). Deleting them was refused by the harness permissions. Owner: `git worktree remove --force ../cvgen-framework-split`, `git branch -D refactor/framework-split`, `git push origin --delete refactor/framework-split`.
- **Consent wording and retention:** the intake's consent line promises deletion 12 months after delivery; plain wording, not lawyer-reviewed. Owner may change either.
- **vision.md** now opens with the owner's own description ("hand-crafted, premium CVs made with AI on our own Typst framework") ahead of "a library of...". Owner to confirm or reword.
- **Idea-gate exception** in docs/review.md (adopted by the lead 2026-09-25): confirm or refuse.
- **Two pending proposals** (ceo run): certificate-validity-check, vessel-particulars. candidate-intake was rejected as superseded by the client workflow (owner, 2026-09-25).
- **Three proposed design concepts** in design-concepts/: keep, drop or steer. Two have travel versions (Measured in Months, Feature Opener), relevant to a tour-guide client.
- **Root exports/ PDFs** still carry "Marine CV" metadata; regenerating them replaces files in exports/ (owner-reserved).
- **D11:** the engineer example names a real academy; changing it breaks the frozen v11 reference.
- **Stray file** /tmp/a.txt from a reviewer; deleting it is the owner's call.

## Pitfalls that cost time
- Windows console is cp1252: subprocess text needs `encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'`.
- Bash heredocs that run Python or write files sometimes do nothing on this machine: write a .py file with the Write tool and run it from PowerShell.
- The Edit tool fails on a file not Read in this session; a failed edit followed by `git add` committed a conflict marker once during a rebase (aborted and redone). Check `git grep '^<<<<<<<'` before `rebase --continue`.
- `Remove-Item -Recurse` under builds/ was denied by the harness this session.
- The workflow test asserts `engine_uncommitted_changes is False`: commit engine changes (cv-framework or domains) before `python tests/run.py`.
- pymupdf: read `len(doc)` inside the `with` block.
- Forks cannot spawn the code-reviewer; the lead runs review rounds. The research-reviewer never reads private/: pass Deep Dives inline.
- Trello credentials: never assign to a PowerShell variable; board resolved by name 'CVgen'.

## Constraints in force
- Never run `scripts/cv.py approve` on a real client.
- Outside private/, a client is only ever their Alias (client-yyyy-mm-nn).
- Authority: agents act without asking on routine Git and board work and on glossary terms (reported afterwards). Owner-reserved list: docs/preferences.md only.
- ICS VCR repos follow their own rules.

# revision-snapshot: include sibling data files a custom entry point reads

Owner: unassigned. Found by the docs-audit review round 2 (R2-N3), 2026-09-25; code reading only, not reproduced on the real workspace.

## Problem
`cv_workflow/render.py` snapshots `cv.typ`, `candidate.json` and the portrait into `revisions/<id>/inputs/`. A custom composition (build-a-cv section 8) that also reads a sibling file such as `presentation.json` either fails inside the snapshot (relative path) or reads the live file (root-absolute path), so the revision is not self-contained and approval does not bind to what was rendered.

## Outcome
Every file an entry point reads with `json(...)`/`read(...)`/`image(...)` from its workspace is snapshotted with its hash in `render.json`, or the render refuses with a message naming the file.

## Acceptance
- A workflow test with a sibling data file renders from the snapshot alone.
- Suite green; review PASS.

- **Idea-gate exception** in docs/review.md (adopted by the lead 2026-09-25): output of an idea run confined to design-concepts/, the run folder and pending proposals merges on the idea gates without a code-reviewer round. Confirm or refuse; replace the parenthesis with his dated decision.
- **Three pending proposals** (ceo run, all recommend Approve): certificate-validity-check (expired cert fails render checks; 0.5-1 day), vessel-particulars (GT, engine maker, kW per vessel; 1.5-2 days, slot with item 3), candidate-intake (client questionnaire; 0.5 day). Written before candidate-validation and item 4 landed; their "opened"/"after item 4" wording is now dated.
- **Three proposed design concepts** in design-concepts/ (README table): Measured in Months, Feature Opener, Fleet in Signs. Keep, drop or steer.
- **Root exports/ PDFs** still carry "Marine CV" in their metadata; regenerating them replaces files in exports/ (owner-reserved).
- **D11:** the engineer example names a real academy in its education entry; changing it breaks the frozen v11 reference (new reference + ADR).
- **Stray file** `/tmp/a.txt` written by a reviewer outside the repo; deleting it is the owner's call.
- trello-cli card: act only on its triggers.

## Pitfalls that cost time
- Windows console is cp1252: subprocess text from Typst/git needs `encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'`.
- Python `write_text` writes CRLF on Windows; the repo is LF-only (`newline='\n'`).
- Bash heredoc Python edits and `git commit` chained in Bash sometimes silently do nothing on this machine; use the Edit tool and PowerShell for commits, then check `git log`.
- `git add -A` in a worktree where an agent is still writing captures its half-done files; stage paths explicitly.
- The workflow test asserts `engine_uncommitted_changes is False`: commit engine changes before `python tests/run.py`.
- Forks cannot spawn the code-reviewer; the lead runs review rounds.
- A function stored in a Typst dictionary is called `(model.count)(x)`.
- Trello credentials: never assign to a PowerShell variable; board resolved by name `'CVgen'`.
- Identical inputs do not give identical PDF bytes; approval binds to bytes. Compiling a concept rewrites its committed PDF.

## Constraints in force
- Never run `scripts/cv.py approve` on a real candidate.
- Authority (owner, 2026-09-25): agents act without asking on routine Git and board work, including merges to main, branch/worktree cleanup and history edits on feature work. Owner-reserved list: docs/preferences.md only. `.claude/settings.local.json` holds matching allow/deny rules; start sessions inside `cvgen`.
- ICS VCR repos follow their own rules.

## Steps
1. Targeted research (30-45 min), sources cited in the agent files: current Claude Code subagent format (frontmatter, tools incl. web search, model/effort), writing briefs that give sharp rather than generic output, font licensing for bundled Typst fonts, trustworthy editorial-design sources. Market and trend research stays inside the agents' runs.
2. Write both agent files; document them in AGENTS.md "Skills and agents".
3. First runs: editor -> 2-3 concepts with PDFs; CEO -> market scan + up to 3 proposals.

- Owner opens the concept PDFs and proposals in the morning without reading code.
- No product decision taken by either agent; proposals are `pending`.
- CEO cadence recommendation: weekly, not nightly (agent's pushback, 2026-09-25).
## Owner addition 2026-09-25: closed review loops
Each creator gets a counterpart reviewer, and web research gets one too:
- **ceo-reviewer** judges each idea: real user need, fits the vision, smallest version honest, cost/risk realistic, not a duplicate of the roadmap.
- **design-reviewer** judges each concept PDF: premium and distinct from Flagship, readable as a CV, prints cleanly, fictional data, OFL fonts, no copying.
- **research-reviewer** checks any web research (the creators' and the upfront research): sources exist, are current, and say what is claimed.
Loop: author revises until the reviewer passes; max 5 rounds when the owner is attending, 10 when unattended (owner, 2026-09-25); still failing -> reaches the owner marked unresolved with the reviewer's reason. Calibration (owner): decently strict, not perfectionist; the niche is custom, unique, premium work. Reviewers fail generic, copied or unsupported work; taste nitpicks are notes, not failures.

# idea-agents: CEO and magazine-editor subagents (research first, first runs)

Owner: Claude Code, overnight run. Requested by the owner 2026-09-25. Integration target: `main`.

## Outcome
Two subagents under `.claude/agents/` that only propose, never decide or merge:
- **ceo**: reads vision, roadmap, framework gaps, board, history, current examples; researches the CV/recruiting market; returns at most 3 roadmap-aware ideas per run (who it helps, smallest shippable version, cost, risk, roadmap slot), each saved as a `pending` proposal under `docs/proposals/`.
- **magazine-editor**: studies editorial design and `archive/design-studies/`; returns 2-3 template concepts per run, each with a one-page Typst mock-up PDF on fictional data. Never touches the frozen engine or Flagship; inspiration, never copies a publication's layout or branding; OFL-licensed fonts only.

## Steps
1. Targeted research (30-45 min), sources cited in the agent files: current Claude Code subagent format (frontmatter, tools incl. web search, model/effort), writing briefs that give sharp rather than generic output, font licensing for bundled Typst fonts, trustworthy editorial-design sources. Market and trend research stays inside the agents' runs.
2. Write both agent files; document them in AGENTS.md "Skills and agents".
3. First runs: editor -> 2-3 concepts with PDFs; CEO -> market scan + up to 3 proposals.
4. Review round under docs/review.md, merge, report with links to the PDFs and proposals.

## Acceptance
- Owner opens the concept PDFs and proposals in the morning without reading code.
- No product decision taken by either agent; proposals are `pending`.
- CEO cadence recommendation: weekly, not nightly (agent's pushback, 2026-09-25).
## Owner addition 2026-09-25: closed review loops
Each creator gets a counterpart reviewer, and web research gets one too:
- **ceo-reviewer** judges each idea: real user need, fits the vision, smallest version honest, cost/risk realistic, not a duplicate of the roadmap.
- **design-reviewer** judges each concept PDF: premium and distinct from Flagship, readable as a CV, prints cleanly, fictional data, OFL fonts, no copying.
- **research-reviewer** checks any web research (the creators' and the upfront research): sources exist, are current, and say what is claimed.
Loop: author revises until the reviewer passes; max 3 rounds; still failing -> reaches the owner marked unresolved with the reviewer's reason. Calibration (owner): decently strict, not perfectionist; the niche is custom, unique, premium work. Reviewers fail generic, copied or unsupported work; taste nitpicks are notes, not failures.

Rewritten in place at the end of every session; the first thing a fresh session reads after AGENTS.md. Holds only what no task card owns: what is next, parked owner decisions, machine facts, pitfalls. Task state stays on the task cards.

**Written:** 2026-09-21, end of the overnight ADR 0011 run (Claude Code).

## Where things stand
- The project is **CVgen**: repository https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen (renamed 2026-09-21, old URL redirects), Typst package `cvgen`, this board renamed from "Marine CV" (same id IPsBxAwf). The owner's local folder is still `marine-engineer-cv`.
- `main` at 422f150, pushed, CI green, working tree clean. All four ADR 0011 stages merged the same night, each with a PASS review round: domains-adr (b54d9f9), domains-move (195fbab), domains-core-split (3296e91), rename-cvgen (422f150). Tag `archive/pre-domains` marks the tree before the move.
- Engine layout now: `packages/cv-engine/core/` (field-neutral, never imports a domain; the suite asserts it), `domains/marine/{domain.typ,data.typ,schema,assets,roles/deck,roles/engine,templates/flagship}`, `examples/marine/flagship/`. Entry points take six inputs (candidate, role, theme, artwork, layout, durations switch). Read `docs/reference/domains-and-roles.md` before adding a field.
- Suite: 38 cases, engineer example pixel-identical to the frozen v11 (last run builds/tests-20260921-024344-571120). Four example PDFs build.
- Both private workspaces repathed (imports only; records untouched) and render pixel-identical to their `reference.pdf` (builds/private-repath-20260921/). `scripts/cv.py render private/<private-envelope>` produced revision 20260920-231519-b39c17, sha256 510f8a9b..., checks passed, NOT approved (owner's act).
- Review note N4 on pdf-workflow closed (wrong-shape JSON records read `corrupt`, review 04 PASS).
- Not built by design: `apps/web/`; travel-and-tourism domain (next product item).

## Next
0. A one-shot briefing note is waiting at .local/RAMP-UP-NOTE.md (git-excluded). At the owner's first ramp-up after 2026-09-21: deliver it, then delete it in the same turn (owner's explicit instruction). Then remove this line.
1. Orient per docs/development.md (AGENTS.md, preferences, this card, `-Cards 'CVgen'`, git state) and give the Goal / Now / Next / You briefing.
2. Owner's client CV: find out the field. Marine -> `new-cv` skill against the new layout (root-absolute imports, `role:` line). Any other field -> open the `travel-and-tourism` (or that field's) domain card first: `domains/<field>/{domain.typ,data.typ,schema,assets,templates/<design>}` plus `examples/<field>/`, touching neither `core/` nor `domains/marine/` (ADR 0011). Reviewer note N1 on domains-core-split: `core/page.typ` still reads `candidate.copy.brand` and `candidate.disclosure`; a new domain's template must supply them or bypass `document-shell`.
3. Otherwise pick a parked item below with the owner and record the decision on the board.

## Parked owner decisions
- Remove the empty trial worktree: `git worktree remove ..\marine-engineer-cv-trial-wt` (exact-command checkpoint; still present, detached at c39ca1e).
- Delete merged branches (destructive, needs the go): `git branch -d chore/rename-cvgen docs/product-direction feat/monorepo-migration feat/pdf-workflow fix/status-wrong-shape refactor/agent-ready-layout refactor/domains-move refactor/domains-core docs/adr-0011-domains` and the same on origin.
- Rename the local checkout folder to `cvgen` (moves Claude's project memory path; owner's machine).
- `domain.meta` still says "Marine CV" / "Marine CV Studio" (PDF metadata of marine CVs, pixel-neutral). Keep or change to CVgen: owner's call.
- trello-cli card: act only on its triggers.

## Pitfalls that cost time
- Windows console is cp1252: subprocess text output from Typst/git needs `encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'` (see `TEXT` in `packages/cv-workflow/cv_workflow/render.py`).
- Python `write_text` on Windows writes CRLF; the repo is LF-only - pass `newline='\n'` for scripted doc edits.
- The workflow test asserts `engine_uncommitted_changes is False`: commit engine changes before `python tests/run.py`, or the last case fails for that reason alone.
- A function stored in a Typst dictionary is called `(model.count)(x)`; `model.count(x)` does not compile.
- Trello credentials: load them from `$PROFILE.CurrentUserCurrentHost` in each tool shell; never assign to a PowerShell variable. The board is resolved by exact name (`'CVgen'`).
- Typst `image()` resolves relative to the engine component, so `identity.portrait` is root-absolute unless rendered through `scripts/cv.py`.
- Identical inputs do not give identical PDF bytes; approval binds to bytes.

## Constraints in force
- Never run `scripts/cv.py approve` on a real candidate; `--test-only` is refused under `private/`.
- Nothing under `private/` changes without the owner's go (the 2026-09-21 repath was authorised as "complete unfinished tasks"). Deletions, overwrites, worktree removal and destructive git need a checkpoint with the exact command.
- Routine merges to `main` are authorised here (AGENTS.md); ICS VCR repos follow their own rule.

# monorepo-migration: move the repository to the approved layout (ADR 0010)

Owner: Claude Code. Branch: `feat/monorepo-migration` (feature branch; substantial change).
Integration target: `main`. Depends on: none (dev-setup Done, Trello adopted).

## Outcome and boundaries
The repository follows the target tree in docs/pdf-workflow.md: candidate facts are separated from the Flagship template's input contract and connected through the template adapter; presentation stays owned by the template. Fictional examples are organised per the approved layout: three candidate datasets covering deck and engine, one example per supported template/dataset combination. Historical design studies stay together.
Excludes: component rewrite, a speculative shared marine schema, new templates just to fill a matrix, any change to frozen reference bytes or accepted baselines, the PDF workflow commands (next card).

## Acceptance
See checklist. Evidence per item goes in the card or in `docs/work/monorepo-migration/`.

## Links
- ADR 0010: https://github.com/jimzord12/marine-engineer-cv/blob/main/docs/decisions/0010-public-monorepo-and-pdf-workflow.md
- Target tree and lifecycle: https://github.com/jimzord12/marine-engineer-cv/blob/main/docs/pdf-workflow.md
- Working rules: https://github.com/jimzord12/marine-engineer-cv/blob/main/docs/development.md
- Baseline before moving code: `python tests/run.py` PASS, 24 cases, builds/tests-20260916-154403-397582 (local)

## Result and evidence
Branch `feat/monorepo-migration`, commits d0978b2 (move + adapter + third dataset), f122de8 (schema formatting), fe9bd1d (docs + gallery PDF). CI green on fe9bd1d: https://github.com/jimzord12/marine-engineer-cv/actions?query=branch%3Afeat%2Fmonorepo-migration
- Suite: `python tests/run.py` PASS, 26 cases (was 24), builds/tests-20260916-205345-010752 (local).
- Frozen reference: engineer example pixel- and text-identical to Marine-Engineer-CV-v11.pdf from the new tree (suite gate `exact`).
- tests/baseline.json: 31 entries re-keyed; 29 hash values carried over unchanged (reference PDF, 3 fonts, 18 assets, 7 design-study files). Two changed: the engineer and captain records, each a one-line portrait path edit (`/assets/...` -> `/examples/candidates/...`), shown in commit d0978b2.
- Contracts: packages/cv-engine/schema/candidate.schema.json (facts) and templates/flagship/schema/flagship-input.schema.json (facts + copy); templates/flagship/adapter/adapter.typ owns Flagship wording; all three records validate against both.
- Third dataset: examples/candidates/chief-officer-example.json (deck, no portrait) + examples/flagship/chief-officer.typ, silver theme; rendered pages inspected; exports/Marine-Chief-Officer-CV-Silver-v01.pdf.
- Existing deliverables: rebuilt PDFs raster- and text-identical to the committed exports (only the creation timestamp differs); exports untouched.
- Durations switch: covered by the `engineer-hidden` and `long-hidden` cases; build.ps1 -HideVesselDurations path updated.
- Packaging/privacy: typst.toml moved into the package with exclude = templates/flagship/tests; private/ and builds/ still ignored; git grep for old paths in active docs clean.
- Legacy private entry points (2 real candidates, untouched): they import `../../themes/...`, `../../src/...` and `/assets/...`; after this change they fail to compile until their imports become `../../packages/cv-engine/...` and asset paths `/packages/cv-engine/templates/flagship/assets/...`. Candidate records were not modified. Owner to decide when to touch them. (Both compose pages by hand and read the record's `copy` directly, so the adapter's merge does not affect them; only the paths break.)
- Design studies: moved unchanged to archive/design-studies (hashes pinned); they no longer compile in place; README explains recompiling from tag `archive/pre-monorepo`.

## Review
Round 1 on fe9bd1d, lead lenses 3 and 4: https://github.com/jimzord12/marine-engineer-cv/blob/feat/monorepo-migration/docs/work/monorepo-migration/reviews/01.md - FINDINGS. M1 (candidate-schema reference described the old copy contract) fixed; M2 (stale paths in skills/references, silent --font-path fonts) fixed; m1 previews re-rendered from the committed export into docs/images; m2 precedence test tightened; m3 verification.md, .gitignore, .gitattributes, README gallery fixed; N1 card statement corrected. All in commit after fe9bd1d.

Started 2026-09-16 on branch `feat/monorepo-migration` from `main` e72d46a; pre-migration snapshot tagged `archive/pre-monorepo`.

# idea-agents: CEO and magazine-editor subagents (research first, first runs)

Owner: Claude Code, overnight run. Requested by the owner 2026-09-25. Integration target: `main`.

## Outcome
Two subagents under `.claude/agents/` that only propose, never decide or merge:
- **ceo**: reads vision, roadmap, framework gaps, board, history, current examples; researches the CV/recruiting market; returns at most 3 roadmap-aware ideas per run (who it helps, smallest shippable version, cost, risk, roadmap slot), each saved as a `pending` proposal under `docs/proposals/`.
- **magazine-editor**: studies editorial design and `archive/design-studies/`; returns 2-3 template concepts per run, each with a one-page Typst mock-up PDF on fictional data. Never touches the frozen engine or Flagship; inspiration, never copies a publication's layout or branding; OFL-licensed fonts only.

## Steps
1. Targeted research (30-45 min), sources cited in the agent files: current Claude Code subagent format (frontmatter, tools incl. web search, model/effort), writing briefs that give sharp rather than generic output, font licensing for bundled Typst fonts, trustworthy editorial-design sources. Market and trend research stays inside the agents' runs.
2. Write both agent files; document them in AGENTS.md "Skills and agents".
3. First runs: editor -> 2-3 concepts with PDFs; CEO -> market scan + up to 3 proposals.
4. Review round under docs/review.md, merge, report with links to the PDFs and proposals.

## Acceptance
- Owner opens the concept PDFs and proposals in the morning without reading code.
- No product decision taken by either agent; proposals are `pending`.
- CEO cadence recommendation: weekly, not nightly (agent's pushback, 2026-09-25).
## Owner addition 2026-09-25: closed review loops
Each creator gets a counterpart reviewer, and web research gets one too:
- **ceo-reviewer** judges each idea: real user need, fits the vision, smallest version honest, cost/risk realistic, not a duplicate of the roadmap.
- **design-reviewer** judges each concept PDF: premium and distinct from Flagship, readable as a CV, prints cleanly, fictional data, OFL fonts, no copying.
- **research-reviewer** checks any web research (the creators' and the upfront research): sources exist, are current, and say what is claimed.
Loop: author revises until the reviewer passes; max 5 rounds when the owner is attending, 10 when unattended (owner, 2026-09-25); still failing -> reaches the owner marked unresolved with the reviewer's reason. Calibration (owner): decently strict, not perfectionist; the niche is custom, unique, premium work. Reviewers fail generic, copied or unsupported work; taste nitpicks are notes, not failures.

Done. Integrated at 8f7bf35; CI verify run 36079889960 success; suite on the merged branch PASS 43 (cvgen-wt-ideas/builds/tests-20260925-035709-054243, worktree since removed). # revision-snapshot: include sibling data files a custom entry point reads

Owner: unassigned. Found by the docs-audit review round 2 (R2-N3), 2026-09-25; code reading only, not reproduced on the real workspace.

## Problem
`cv_workflow/render.py` snapshots `cv.typ`, `candidate.json` and the portrait into `revisions/<id>/inputs/`. A custom composition (build-a-cv section 8) that also reads a sibling file such as `presentation.json` either fails inside the snapshot (relative path) or reads the live file (root-absolute path), so the revision is not self-contained and approval does not bind to what was rendered.

## Outcome
Every file an entry point reads with `json(...)`/`read(...)`/`image(...)` from its workspace is snapshotted with its hash in `render.json`, or the render refuses with a message naming the file.

## Acceptance
- A workflow test with a sibling data file renders from the snapshot alone.
- Suite green; review PASS.

## Added 2026-09-25 (framework-split)
- docs/framework-gaps.md "A client whose domain does not exist yet": a one-off Template must fit in cv.typ because a revision snapshots only cv.typ, candidate.json and the portrait. This card closes that gap.
- Add a suite case to tests/workflow.py: a fictional one-off entry importing only /packages/cv-framework/lib.typ, rendered with --pages 1; assert success and schema null (framework-split review 02, R2-N3).
## What it fixes for a real person (plain words)
When you approve a client's CV, the approval is meant to lock in exactly the files that made that PDF, so the CV you send is the CV you checked. Until tonight a custom CV that kept extra facts in a side file (like the second real client's `presentation.json`) either failed to build from its saved copy or quietly read the live file, which could change after you approved; now every file the CV reads is saved with the revision, and a CV that still reads a live file cannot be approved.

## Result and evidence (Night Shift 2026-09-27)
- Merge: https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen/commit/20622b4 (suite PASS 52 cases on main after merging with certificate-validity-check).
- A revision now copies every workspace file `cv.typ` (or a local helper) reads by a literal path and lists it with its hash in render.json (`inputs.files`); refuses root-absolute reads into private/ or the workspace, paths leaving the workspace, missing files, a file taking the portrait's place; and after the compile, Typst's dependency list turns any `Live Read` (new glossary term) into a failed check, so approval is refused.
- Suite: a Framework-only one-off (schema null, --pages 1) with sibling data, a helper, a read after a URL; it compiles from the snapshot after the live files are deleted.
- Read-only probe of the two real compositions: one reads nothing extra, the other reads presentation.json by a relative path (now snapshotted); neither is refused. Not yet proven by a real render with the dependency check (next real render will show; a misfire would fail loudly, no data risk).
- Framework gap "A client whose domain does not exist yet": snapshot half closed.

## Review
- Round 1 FINDINGS: https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen/blob/main/docs/work/revision-snapshot/reviews/01.md (M1 URL comment stripping hid reads: fixed, plus the dependency-list safety net; m1-m4 fixed).
- Round 2 PASS: https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen/blob/main/docs/work/revision-snapshot/reviews/02.md. R2-m1 (an `include` inside an expression is not found; loud "file not found") documented in the cv-workflow README rather than widened; R2-N1 (check fails open on an odd dependency list or a network share) and round-1 N2 (schema chosen from cv.typ's imports only) deferred for triage.

## Handoff
Done. Deferred for triage: R2-m1, R2-N1, R1-N2 above.

Merged to main as 3296e91 (branch refactor/domains-core, 2 commits). core/ is field-neutral (node.typ, common facts, pagination over a domain row model, shell with title/author); domains/marine/{domain,data}.typ and roles/{deck,engine}; flagship(role:) forwards to the adapter; copy composed domain < role < template < record < call site. **Goal.** One reusable house design for the `Text Draft` (the plain-text CV every client checks before `Sign-off`, client-workflow step 8). Not one per client. Purpose: brand trust. A client who receives something that feels custom-crafted and expensive trusts us before seeing the real CV.

**Owner's direction (2026-09-25, verbatim).**
- "It does not have a soul, character."
- "My vibe is more of a very alternative, sophisticated, not afraid to over do it kinda of an artist."
- "It also need to have a unique style."
- Earlier: "it should have style, feel unique and premium... this is most about brand awareness... quality and custom crafted things are very expensive."

**First attempt: rejected.** Branch `feat/premium-draft` (commit 2a5b337, pushed, NOT merged). Navy ink + one brass accent, GFS Didot display, Source Sans 3 body, dossier-style cover check page, running head and folio. Verdict: "bad... no soul, character." Too safe, too corporate-classic. Keep it only as a reference of what not to do.
- Branch: https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen/tree/feat/premium-draft
- Commit: https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen/commit/2a5b337

**What to aim for instead.**
- An artist's hand, not a law firm: bold, opinionated, maximal where it helps; a signature element someone would recognise without the name on it.
- Still must read easily on a phone for a non-tech-savvy Greek client (the check page is the part they act on).

**Constraints that survive.**
- Greek must set correctly. Of the bundled fonts only GFS Didot and Source Sans 3 cover Greek; a new face needs Greek coverage and an OFL licence.
- Greek capitals drop their accents (the `caps()` helper on the branch does this).
- Client-facing words (name, role, check text, labels) stay per-client parameters; the design itself is fixed.
- Fictional content only in the fixture; suite (`python tests/run.py`) must pass.

**Suggested route.** Run it through the `Idea Run` loop first: `magazine-editor` proposes two or three directions with mock-up PDFs, `design-reviewer` checks them, owner picks one. Then build on a fresh branch from `main` (take the font/caps plumbing from `feat/premium-draft`).

**Done when.** Owner picks a direction, it is built into `scripts/text-draft.typ`, suite passes, one rendered preview shown, owner says yes.
cards.name: premium-text-draft: a Text Draft house design with soul and character

**Goal.** Turn the working CVgen mark into files we can actually use.

**Where it stands (2026-09-25).** Working mark is v3: big black serif "CV", flat, on white, one thin copper thread that wraps the C and curves through the V, loose tail on the right. Image-model render, not a production file.
- File: https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen/blob/main/brand/logos/CVgen_Logo.v3.jpg
- Notes and history (v1 3D mock-up, v2 dropped as a crossed-out CV): https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen/blob/main/brand/README.md

**Brief the owner gave.** Originally "CV" nature-like and "gen" technology-like, blended; then dropped nature: a big CV with "gen" passing inside it. Unique, alternative, sophisticated.

**To do.**
1. Flat vector redraw (SVG), transparent background.
2. Full wordmark: "gen" set small at the thread's right-hand tail (as in v1).
3. Small-size variant with a thicker thread; at 32 px the current one disappears.
4. Record the ink and copper colour values in brand/README.md.
5. Optional: the thread as the signature element of premium-text-draft.

**Open point from Claude.** Copper + classic serif reads elegant/luxury, closer to "sophisticated" than "alternative artist". Revisit together with premium-text-draft so the two feel like one brand.
## Night Shift 2026-09-27: vector options delivered (owner to pick)
- Files on main: https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen/tree/main/brand/logos (mark, wordmark with "gen", small mark, padded avatar, bold alternative, and reversed versions for dark backgrounds). Colours and fonts: https://github.com/jimzord12/cvgen/blob/main/brand/README.md
- Ink #131210, copper #B7713D (sampled from v3); reversed ink #F4EFE6, reversed copper #C07B45. Letters: Cormorant Garamond Bold outlines; "gen": Jost Light (both OFL).
- Small mark reads as CV with a visible copper thread at 32 px; at 16 px it is faint (32 px is the practical minimum).
